name: [NEW MAP] Escape The Darkness
desc:
Escape The Darkness has now officially shut down. Thank you for everyone who played and enjoyed our game, it was a passion project from start to finish and to have that experience is something we wouldn't trade for the world. For now, we can only apologize for upsetting our players, but as some doors close, others will open, and we hope that we can make things better going forward.

[CONTROLS]
Crouch - Left Ctrl (B on gamepad)
Attack - Left Mouse (R2 on gamepad)
